english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for pausing because of doubt, uncertainty, or reluctance before acting.

examples.english: I don't want to miss the opportunity because of a moment of hesitation.
examples.traditional: 我唔想因為一時猶豫而錯過機會。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 jan1 wai6 jat1 si4 jau4 jyu6 ji4 co3 gwo3 gei1 wui6
